errors.evidence: Several numerical values for the LLaMA-3-8B-it model are inaccurate. For MBPP, the score is ~61%, not 59%. For LC AlpacaEval-2, the score is ~23%, not 20%. For Chat-Arena-Hard, the score is ~21%, not 18%.

Several numerical values for the 'Ours (Iterative RLHF)' model are inaccurate. For HumanEval, the score is ~64%, not 62%. For MBPP, the score is ~61%, not 60%. For LC AlpacaEval-2, the score is ~31% (visibly over 30), not 28%. For Chat-Arena-Hard, the score is ~29%, not 26%.
